Here is a detailed description of the methodology diagram:

### Overall Layout and Style

The diagram is a clean, minimalist, and elegant academic pipeline illustration presented on a pure white background. The overall flow is horizontal, moving from left to right across three distinct stages. The visual style is sophisticated and publication-ready, suitable for a top-tier conference paper. It uses a muted, professional color palette and a modern, clean sans-serif font (e.g., Helvetica or Inter) for all text. There are no borders, gridlines, or axis marks on the canvas.

### Stage 1: Model Zoo (Left Section)

This section, titled **"Model Zoo"**, is positioned on the far left. It visually represents the collection of models being analyzed.

*   **Structure:** Three model architecture families are stacked vertically. Each family is presented within its own subtle, light-gray card with soft rounded corners and a very faint drop shadow to give it a slight lift from the page.
*   **Components per Family:**
    *   **GDN:** The top card contains two horizontally-aligned, rounded pill-shaped buttons. The left pill has a light sky-blue fill and is labeled "Pure". The right pill has a darker, deep royal-blue fill and is labeled "+Attn". Below this card, the text "GDN" is written in the same deep royal-blue color.
    *   **RetNet:** The middle card follows the same layout. The "Pure" pill has a light, soft coral fill, and the "+Attn" pill has a darker, terracotta-coral fill. Below the card, the text "RetNet" is written in the terracotta-coral color.
    *   **HGRN2:** The bottom card features a "Pure" pill with a light teal-green fill and an "+Attn" pill with a dark sea-green fill. Below the card, the text "HGRN2" is written in the dark sea-green color.

### Stage 2: Per-Example Decomposition (Center Section)

This central stage, titled **"Per-Example Decomposition"**, illustrates the process of categorizing individual data examples based on model performance.

*   **Visualization:** The panel depicts a conceptual sorting process. A scattered group of small, solid-colored circles representing data points are shown being categorized into three distinct buckets or groups.
*   **Categories:**
    *   **"helped" bucket:** This group contains three small circles with a warm amber fill. A label "helped" is placed next to this group.
    *   **"hurt" bucket:** This group contains two small circles with a muted, dusty rose fill. A label "hurt" is placed next to it.
    *   **"unchanged" bucket:** This group is the largest, containing five small circles with a light, neutral gray fill. A label "unchanged" is placed next to it.
*   **Annotations:**
    *   A subtitle in italics, "*pure(xᵢ) vs hybrid(xᵢ)*", is placed directly under the main title to clarify the comparison being made.
    *   A footer annotation, "× 3 architecture pairs", is placed at the bottom of the section to indicate this process is repeated for each model family from Stage 1.

### Stage 3: Cross-Architecture Overlap (Right Section)

The final stage on the right, titled **"Cross-Architecture Overlap"**, visualizes the similarity of the "helped" (or "hurt") sets across the different model architectures.

*   **Structure:** The visualization is dominated by three large circles arranged in a triangular formation (one on top, two below).
*   **Key Visual Feature:** The circles are positioned to have minimal, almost-touching overlap. The intersecting area is a very thin sliver, visually representing less than 5% of each circle's area. This design choice is critical to emphasize the low similarity between the sets.
*   **Components:**
    *   The top circle has a deep royal-blue outline and a very light blue fill, corresponding to the GDN model. It is labeled "GDN" on its exterior.
    *   The bottom-left circle has a terracotta-coral outline and a very light coral fill, corresponding to RetNet. It is labeled "RetNet" on its exterior.
    *   The bottom-right circle has a dark sea-green outline and a very light teal fill, corresponding to HGRN2. It is labeled "HGRN2" on its exterior.
*   **Annotations:**
    *   In the geometric center of the three circles, a bold annotation reads "**J ≈ 0.10**", quantifying the low Jaccard similarity.
    *   Below the entire circle arrangement, a concluding statement reads: "low overlap → architecture-specific sensitivity".

### Connections and Flow

*   A thin, elegant, straight black arrow originates from the right edge of the "Model Zoo" section and points directly to the center of the "Per-Example Decomposition" section, indicating the models are used for this analysis.
*   Three thin, elegant black arrows emerge from the right side of the "Per-Example Decomposition" section. They follow a curved path, converging towards the center of the "Cross-Architecture Overlap" section, signifying that the categorized sets from each architecture are the inputs for the overlap analysis.
